title: The exact region between Chatterjee's and Blest's rank correlations
summary: Exact regions between rank correlations describe the set of all pairs of values that two dependence measures can attain simultaneously on the same copula and thus yield sharp inequalities between them. In this paper, we determine the exact region between Chatterjee's rank correlation $ξ$ and Blest's rank correlation $ν$ over the class of all bivariate copulas. Our approach is based on a constrained optimization problem whose solution is characterized by Karush--Kuhn--Tucker conditions.
